description: This file implements GSSAPI (Kerberos-based) HTTP Authentication module for the lighttpd web server. It provides functions for handling Negotiate and Basic authentication schemes, managing Kerberos credentials, and performing security context establishment with GSSAPI. It defines configuration structures, init functions, and request handlers for integrating Kerberos authentication into the server.
